id: title:ablaszkiewicz:add release mode to proguard upload

review.posthog_relevance: Potential future support for ProGuard mapping ingestion without explicit release binding, currently unverified.
review.reason: The change adds a CLI-only release mode and its implementation. No backend, database, or ingestion changes are supplied, and no tier assignment is possible.
review.uncertainty: This is a CLI-only change; the benefit is unverified and dependent on future backend support.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a CLI-only change. No PostHog backend, database, or ingestion changes are supplied. No tier assignment is possible.

observations.behavior: Adds a new release mode and its implementation.
observations.posthog_connection: This could allow a PostHog user to upload ProGuard mappings without binding them to a release, potentially supporting a future feature where exceptions resolve release metadata from the event itself rather than the mapping. This is currently an experimental CLI-only change; no backend support or ingestion changes are supplied, so the benefit is unverified.
